messages:
Sara (CS): Quick async standup for NovaHealth renewal (Weds).
- What I did: pulled adoption dashboard, confirmed drop in active seats across two teams, triaged support flow. Found export/SSO issues blocking onboarding for new users.
- Blockers: SSO handshake failing for OIDC customers + data export 500s (ticket CS-8912). If we can't onboard their 120 new users, procurement might push discount.
- Today: coordinate hotfix with eng, prep renewal one-pager, update customer timeline.

Tom (CS Manager): Can you paste the minimal repro or logs here and confirm which deployment they run? :eyes:

Sara (CS): Log snippet and ticket below. Shared workspace link (team only): https://app.redwood.com/w/novasupport
```
ERR export failed user=uid_2345 code=500 svc=exporter msg="timeout during kv flush"
RequestID: r_0a9f23cd
Ticket: CS-8912
```
Repro steps added to ticket.

Alex (SE): I'll own the SSO patch. Can someone add exact repro steps (browser, IdP metadata, sample SAML/OIDC assertion)? @Ryan (Eng Runtime) @eng-releases

Ryan (Eng Runtime): Pinged. Quick Q: are they Hosted, Dedicated, or Private? If Private we need infra keys and an HSM snapshot.

Sara (CS): They are on Dedicated (reserved) in us-west-2. Infra has the keys — I DM'd infra for access. Repro steps include failing id_token exchange and export timeout when batch size > 200.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: hotfix branch hotfix/nova-sso -> staging at 11:30am UTC, canary at 12:00pm UTC. CI: green except flake in e2e-auth.

Tom (CS Manager): Good. Sara — can you draft a 1-pager for renewal that includes: current adoption metrics, blocked seats, mitigation plan + timeline? Need by EOD so renewal team can review. :thumbsup:

Sara (CS): On it. If eng can prioritize hotfix today we keep renewal on Wed.

Alex (SE): Starting the PR now, will tag @eng-releases for expedited review. ETA for PR: 15:00 UTC.

Maria (CSM): FYI procurement asked for 30% concession if rollout incomplete by renewal date. I'll include that as a negotiation scenario in the doc.

Sara (CS): Thanks — I'll update CS-8912 with timeline and mark renewal as 'at-risk' for visibility. Adding notes for follow-up call with customer tomorrow 09:00 PT. :spiral_calendar:

Tom (CS Manager): Thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker ping this thread and @me.

Alex (SE): tagging @eng-releases in the PR now.

Ryan (Eng Runtime): I'll standby for logs/access and help validate the canary once deployed.
